items.zh: 运行日志：账号刷新/登录失败、插件日志、核心内部事件统一落库，日志页新增「运行日志」标签，点击行看明细并可导出 JSON
items.en: Run logs: account refresh/login failures, plugin logs and core events are persisted; a new Run Logs tab shows details per row with JSON export

items.zh: 运行日志级别可配：error / warn / debug / info 递增包含，默认 error；debug 级可查看上游请求与响应明细
items.en: Configurable run-log level: error / warn / debug / info (cumulative), default error; debug captures upstream request and response details

items.zh: 任务偏移可配：daily 任务触发抖动窗口由固定 30 分钟改为可配（0–45 分钟，0 = 关闭偏移）
items.en: Configurable task jitter: the daily trigger window is now adjustable (0–45 minutes, 0 = disabled) instead of a fixed 30 minutes

items.zh: 调用日志区分同步/流式，列表新增类型列
items.en: Request logs now distinguish streaming from synchronous calls with a new type column

items.zh: 账号测试诊断增强：回传信封请求与事件明细，可一键导出 JSON；扫码登录的二维码直接内联展示
items.en: Richer account test diagnostics: envelope request and event stream are returned with one-click JSON export; QR logins render inline

items.zh: 系统默认实例不再显示名称/站点地址输入；插件与实例设置弹窗打开即预填默认值
items.en: System default instances no longer expose name/base URL fields; plugin and instance setting dialogs prefill schema defaults on open
